name: Nicolas Uhres — birth about 1856, Keispelt, Luxembourg
researcher_question: When and where was Nicolas Uhres born, the husband of Marguerite Birchen and father of Johann (born 1883) and Josephine (born 1885) Uhres of Keispelt, Luxembourg?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 16, hint-samples.csv row 552, flag adds_birth, confidence 3). Re-adjudicated 2026-10-14: different answer — the hint record (6PBG-1Q63, 1880, born 1856) belongs to a separate Nicolas Uhres. The tree person GYGJ-D1C was born 13 May 1858 in Keispelt per the 1890 Kehlen census (ark:/61903/1:1:659M-7Z13). Two men named Nicolas Uhres coexisted in Kehlen; the 1885 census shows both simultaneously.
